quotelist.quote: Shop the Fish 3D Directional Flat Top Snowboard and other all mountain, park, and powder boards from Burton.

quotelist.quote: Directional Flat Top™ – Flat overall with a rocker nose for the steady stability and effortless float demanded by deep days and surfy terrain.
Directional Flex – This flex features increased pop in the tail and a more resilient nose that allows riders to easily maintain control through all terrain and conditions.

citation.reasoning: evo.com is a major authorized Burton retailer. Their product listing for the 2027 "Flat Top" version provides official Burton technology descriptions.

quotelist.quote: The Burton Fish 3D is the evolution of the famous Burton Fish, a worldwide favourite season after season.
45° Carbon Highlights is a tip to tail carbon layer reduces weight and contains 45° angled fibres, fine tuning the torsional flex.

citation.reasoning: Melbourne Snowboard Centre is the merchant source for the 2027 model. Their product descriptions align with Burton's official specifications and provide the detailed technology breakdowns.

quotelist.quote: The design is the result of more on-snow prototypes than any board in recent years and gives the Fish a new level of surfability.

citation.reasoning: Salty Peaks is an established snowboard shop carrying authorized Burton product with standard Burton descriptions.
